What is VHDL and how does it differ from Verilog?

VHDL (VHSIC Hardware Description Language) is an IEEE-standard (1076) HDL for digital design, simulation, and synthesis. Strongly typed, verbose, and precise.

**VHDL vs Verilog:**
| | VHDL | Verilog |
|-|-|-|
| Typing | Strong (explicit types) | Weak (implicit conversions) |
| Verbosity | More verbose | Concise |
| Usage | Defense, aerospace, Europe | Industry, US, Asia |
| Case | Case-insensitive | Case-sensitive |

Tools: GHDL (open-source), Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus, ModelSim.

```bash
ghdl -a hello.vhd    # analyze
ghdl -e hello        # elaborate
ghdl -r hello        # run
```

```vhdl
-- hello.vhd
library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;

entity hello is
end entity hello;

architecture sim of hello is
begin
    process
    begin
        report "Hello, World!";
        wait;
    end process;
end architecture sim;
```

```vhdl
-- Use ieee.numeric_std (preferred — avoid std_logic_arith!)
library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;

-- Key numeric_std operations:
-- Arithmetic: u1 + u2, u1 - u2, u1 * u2
-- Comparison: u1 < u2, u1 = u2
-- Shift:    shift_left(u, n), shift_right(u, n)
-- Rotate:   rotate_left(u, n)
-- Resize:   resize(u, new_width)  -- zero/sign extends

-- Conversion cheatsheet:
-- unsigned(slv)              slv -> unsigned
-- signed(slv)                slv -> signed
-- std_logic_vector(u)        unsigned -> slv
-- to_integer(uns)            unsigned -> integer
-- to_unsigned(42, 8)         integer -> unsigned
-- to_signed(-10, 8)          integer -> signed

-- Bit manipulation:
-- bus8(7)              single bit
-- bus8(7 downto 4)     slice (4-bit slv)
-- bus8 <= (others => '0');        all zeros
-- bus8 <= (7 => '1', others => '0');  bit 7 set
-- result <= a & b;     concatenation (8+8=16 bits)

-- VHDL 2008 features:
-- Matching case: case? (matches std_logic don't-cares)
-- Conditional in concurrent: y <= a when cond else b;
-- ghdl -a --std=08 file.vhd   -- compile as VHDL 2008

-- GHDL workflow:
-- ghdl -a --std=08 adder.vhd tb_adder.vhd
-- ghdl -e --std=08 tb_adder
-- ghdl -r --std=08 tb_adder --vcd=waves.vcd
-- gtkwave waves.vcd
```
